summary: An 18 tile grid of solid Surfaces crossing six tones with three variants.
use: Picking the tone and variant of a surface for status, brand or neutral emphasis.
spec: `<Surface material="solid" elevation={1} {tone} {variant} p="3" class="tile">` in nested `{#each variants as variant (variant)}` and `{#each tones as tone (tone)}` loops
Each tile prints its tone and variant name
